import Mathlib

structure BinaryMaxHeap where
  storage : List Int
deriving Inhabited

namespace BinaryMaxHeap

def len (h : BinaryMaxHeap) : Nat :=
  h.storage.length

def get (h : BinaryMaxHeap) (i : Nat) : Int :=
  h.storage.getD i 0

def parent (i : Nat) : Nat := (i - 1) / 2

def is_heap (h : BinaryMaxHeap) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, 0 < i ∧ i < h.len → h.get i ≤ h.get (parent i)

def view (h : BinaryMaxHeap) : Multiset Int :=
  Multiset.ofList h.storage

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def pop_max_precond (h : BinaryMaxHeap) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_heap h ∧ h.len > 0
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

def insertDesc (a : Int) : List Int → List Int
  | [] => [a]
  | b :: bs => if b < a then a :: b :: bs else b :: insertDesc a bs

def sortDesc : List Int → List Int
  | [] => []
  | a :: as => insertDesc a (sortDesc as)

def SortedDesc : List Int → Prop
  | [] => True
  | a :: as => SortedDesc as ∧ ∀ x ∈ as, x ≤ a

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
-- Returns (new_heap, popped_max)
def pop_max (h : BinaryMaxHeap)
    (h_precond : pop_max_precond h) : BinaryMaxHeap × Int :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  let _pos : h.len > 0 := h_precond.2
  ({ storage := sortDesc h.storage.tail }, h.get 0)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def pop_max_postcond (h : BinaryMaxHeap) (result : BinaryMaxHeap × Int)
    (_ : pop_max_precond h) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  let (new_h, max_val) := result
  is_heap new_h ∧
  new_h.len = h.len - 1 ∧
  (∀ x ∈ h.view, max_val ≥ x) ∧
  new_h.view = h.view - {max_val}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

lemma mem_insertDesc {x a : Int} {l : List Int} :
    x ∈ insertDesc a l ↔ x = a ∨ x ∈ l := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp [insertDesc]
  | cons b bs ih =>
      by_cases hb : b < a
      · simp [insertDesc, hb]
      · simp only [insertDesc, hb, if_false, List.mem_cons, ih]
        tauto

@[simp]
lemma length_insertDesc (a : Int) (l : List Int) :
    (insertDesc a l).length = l.length + 1 := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp [insertDesc]
  | cons b bs ih =>
      by_cases h : b < a
      · simp [insertDesc, h]
      · simp [insertDesc, h, ih, Nat.add_assoc]

@[simp]
lemma length_sortDesc (l : List Int) :
    (sortDesc l).length = l.length := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp [sortDesc]
  | cons a as ih =>
      simp [sortDesc, ih]

lemma perm_insertDesc (a : Int) (l : List Int) :
    (insertDesc a l).Perm (a :: l) := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp [insertDesc]
  | cons b bs ih =>
      by_cases h : b < a
      · simp [insertDesc, h]
      · dsimp [insertDesc]
        rw [if_neg h]
        exact (List.Perm.cons b ih).trans (List.Perm.swap a b bs)

lemma perm_sortDesc (l : List Int) :
    (sortDesc l).Perm l := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp [sortDesc]
  | cons a as ih =>
      dsimp [sortDesc]
      exact (perm_insertDesc a (sortDesc as)).trans (List.Perm.cons a ih)

lemma ofList_sortDesc (l : List Int) :
    Multiset.ofList (sortDesc l) = Multiset.ofList l := by
  exact Quot.sound (perm_sortDesc l)

lemma sortedDesc_insertDesc (a : Int) {l : List Int}
    (hs : SortedDesc l) : SortedDesc (insertDesc a l) := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp [insertDesc, SortedDesc]
  | cons b bs ih =>
      change SortedDesc bs ∧ (∀ x ∈ bs, x ≤ b) at hs
      rcases hs with ⟨hsbs, hall⟩
      by_cases h : b < a
      · dsimp [insertDesc]
        rw [if_pos h]
        change SortedDesc (b :: bs) ∧ ∀ x ∈ b :: bs, x ≤ a
        constructor
        · exact ⟨hsbs, hall⟩
        · intro x hx
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hxbs
          · exact le_of_lt h
          · exact le_trans (hall x hxbs) (le_of_lt h)
      · dsimp [insertDesc]
        rw [if_neg h]
        change SortedDesc (insertDesc a bs) ∧ ∀ x ∈ insertDesc a bs, x ≤ b
        constructor
        · exact ih hsbs
        · intro x hx
          rcases (mem_insertDesc.mp hx) with rfl | hxbs
          · exact not_lt.mp h
          · exact hall x hxbs

lemma sortedDesc_sortDesc (l : List Int) :
    SortedDesc (sortDesc l) := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp [sortDesc, SortedDesc]
  | cons a as ih =>
      simpa [sortDesc] using sortedDesc_insertDesc a ih

lemma getD_mem_of_lt (l : List Int) (d : Int) {n : Nat}
    (h : n < l.length) : l.getD n d ∈ l := by
  induction l generalizing n with
  | nil =>
      simp at h
  | cons a as ih =>
      cases n with
      | zero =>
          simp [List.getD]
      | succ n =>
          have hn : n < as.length := Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp h
          have hmem : as.getD n d ∈ as := ih hn
          exact List.mem_cons_of_mem a hmem

lemma exists_getD_of_mem {l : List Int} {x : Int}
    (hx : x ∈ l) : ∃ i, i < l.length ∧ l.getD i 0 = x := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp at hx
  | cons a as ih =>
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with hxa | hxas
      · subst hxa
        refine ⟨0, by simp, ?_⟩
        simp [List.getD]
      · rcases ih hxas with ⟨i, hi, hget⟩
        refine ⟨i + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ hi, ?_⟩
        simpa [List.getD, hget]

lemma parent_lt_self {i : Nat} (hi : 0 < i) :
    parent i < i := by
  unfold parent
  have hsub : i - 1 < i := Nat.sub_lt hi Nat.zero_lt_one
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.div_le_self (i - 1) 2) hsub

lemma sortedDesc_getD_le {l : List Int} (hs : SortedDesc l)
    {i j : Nat} (hij : i < j) (hj : j < l.length) :
    l.getD j 0 ≤ l.getD i 0 := by
  induction l generalizing i j with
  | nil =>
      simp at hj
  | cons a as ih =>
      change SortedDesc as ∧ (∀ x ∈ as, x ≤ a) at hs
      rcases hs with ⟨hsas, hall⟩
      cases i with
      | zero =>
          cases j with
          | zero =>
              exact False.elim ((Nat.lt_irrefl 0) hij)
          | succ j =>
              have hj' : j < as.length := Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hj
              have hmem : as.getD j 0 ∈ as := getD_mem_of_lt as 0 hj'
              have hle : as.getD j 0 ≤ a := hall (as.getD j 0) hmem
              simpa [List.getD] using hle
      | succ i =>
          cases j with
          | zero =>
              exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero _ hij)
          | succ j =>
              have hij' : i < j := Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hij
              have hj' : j < as.length := Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hj
              have hle := ih hsas hij' hj'
              simpa [List.getD] using hle

lemma is_heap_of_sortedDesc (l : List Int)
    (hs : SortedDesc l) : is_heap { storage := l } := by
  intro i hi
  rcases hi with ⟨hpos, hilen⟩
  have hp : parent i < i := parent_lt_self hpos
  have hle := sortedDesc_getD_le hs (i := parent i) (j := i) hp (by simpa [len] using hilen)
  simpa [get] using hle

lemma get_le_root (h : BinaryMaxHeap) (hh : is_heap h)
    {i : Nat} (hi : i < h.len) : h.get i ≤ h.get 0 := by
  induction i using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h i ih =>
      by_cases hz : i = 0
      · subst i
        rfl
      · have hpos : 0 < i := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hz
        have hp_lt : parent i < i := parent_lt_self hpos
        have step : h.get i ≤ h.get (parent i) := hh i ⟨hpos, hi⟩
        exact le_trans step (ih (parent i) hp_lt (lt_trans hp_lt hi))

lemma root_ge_of_view_mem (h : BinaryMaxHeap) (hh : is_heap h)
    {x : Int} (hx : x ∈ h.view) : h.get 0 ≥ x := by
  have hxlist : x ∈ h.storage := by
    simpa [view] using hx
  rcases exists_getD_of_mem hxlist with ⟨i, hi, hget⟩
  show x ≤ h.get 0
  rw [← hget]
  simpa [get] using get_le_root h hh (i := i) (by simpa [len] using hi)

-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem pop_max_postcond_satisfied (h : BinaryMaxHeap)
    (h_precond : pop_max_precond h) :
    pop_max_postcond h (pop_max h h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  cases h with
  | mk storage =>
    rcases h_precond with ⟨hh, hlenpos⟩
    cases storage with
    | nil =>
        simp [len] at hlenpos
    | cons a as =>
        dsimp [pop_max_postcond, pop_max, len, get, view, List.getD]
        change
          is_heap { storage := sortDesc as } ∧
          (sortDesc as).length = (a :: as).length - 1 ∧
          (∀ x ∈ Multiset.ofList (a :: as), a ≥ x) ∧
          Multiset.ofList (sortDesc as) = Multiset.ofList (a :: as) - {a}
        constructor
        · exact is_heap_of_sortedDesc _ (sortedDesc_sortDesc _)
        constructor
        · simp
        constructor
        · intro x hx
          have hx' : x ∈ view ({ storage := a :: as } : BinaryMaxHeap) := by
            simpa [view] using hx
          have hmax := root_ge_of_view_mem ({ storage := a :: as } : BinaryMaxHeap) hh hx'
          simpa [get, List.getD] using hmax
        · calc
            Multiset.ofList (sortDesc as) = Multiset.ofList as := ofList_sortDesc as
            _ = Multiset.ofList (a :: as) - {a} := by simp
  -- !benchmark @end proof

end BinaryMaxHeap
